section.name: Agent Sampling Cross-check
section.description: Check counters v. flows for sampling accuracy. Frames estimates from agent data-sources are checked against hardware interface counters. Any that lie outside the 99th percentile confidence interval cause the agent to be listed. The agent with the largest discrepancy is broken out in more detail in the second table, showing the estimates that were outside the confidence interval. Note that in a large network some estimates are expected to fall outside the 99th percentile, but not consistently so.
